proposals.evidence: DEDR5354 gives Tamil vāyil/vāyal/vācal/vāytal doorway, Malayalam vātil, Kannada bāgil/bāgal/bākal, Tulu bādhaḷa and Kota vāl entrance door. Selected southern survey vāsa/vācal/bāsa/vātil/bādal/bāgalu and Kota vāl preserve the documented lateral, dental and sibilant variants and lect contractions. Full doorway-step compounds are kept separate. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

These survey tiṅga/tiṅkiya/tiṅguva/tigɨḷ-type moon responses preserve the same southern family with source lateral weakening, vowel and cluster notation. White-moon compounds are treated separately. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR2599 gives Tamil cīvu to sweep clean and Malayalam cūl broom, beside cīprā/cīpari broom. Survey cīva/cīval/civil/cīvalu-type broom nouns are proposed southern lect extensions of the sweep/broom family with ordinary nominal endings and source vowels retained. Longer bundle compounds are analysed separately. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

These selected southern covatta/cuvanda/cem-/cemappu-type survey responses preserve the documented colour family with lect vowels, nasal/labial developments and ordinary adjective endings. Kannada c-initial loan-looking forms are excluded from this group. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
